title: SAM.gov Scraper – Contracts, Wage Determinations & Grants
description: Scrape live US federal contracting opportunities from SAM.gov — solicitations, sources sought and awards — plus Davis-Bacon/SCA/CBA wage determinations and CFDA grant/loan programs, with no API key and no login. NAICS, set-aside, notice type and state filters, contacts, watch mode.
seoTitle: SAM.gov Scraper — Bids, Wage Determinations & Grants
seoDescription: Scrape SAM.gov contract opportunities, Davis-Bacon/SCA/CBA wage determinations and CFDA grant programs — no API key needed. NAICS/set-aside filters. No start fee.

result.eventDescription: One normalized SAM.gov record returned to the dataset (a contract opportunity, a wage determination, or a CFDA assistance-listing program, depending on data type).
